landing.metaTitle: SLPoliNet — Official video sharing platform for SLPP
landing.metaDescription: SLPoliNet is the official Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna video sharing platform. Browse curated content, publish videos, and share with members and the public.
landing.heroTitle: The official video sharing platform for SLPP
landing.heroSubtitle: Watch, share, and publish Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna content — curated videos, media, and insights for members and audiences everywhere.
landing.step1Body: Members sign in to upload and manage content. New publishers can request access from the platform team.
landing.step2Body: Upload video files, add titles and descriptions in your language, and choose thumbnails.
landing.step3Body: When your video is ready, submit it. Our editorial team reviews before anything goes public.
landing.step4Body: After approval, your video goes live. Share links on WhatsApp, social media, and more.
landing.feature1Body: Every public video is reviewed before it goes live, so viewers get consistent quality from the SLPP network.
landing.feature2Body: Resumable uploads, multilingual metadata, and analytics tuned for serious content publishing.
landing.feature3Body: Adaptive streaming delivers reliable viewing on mobile and desktop.
landing.contactBody: Want to publish on SLPoliNet? Contact the platform team to request member access.

legal.cookiesIntro: Streamora uses cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in and to understand how the platform is used.

cookies.sessionBody: Clerk authentication sets session cookies so you stay signed in securely. These are essential for stakeholder and admin access.
cookies.analyticsBody: When viewers watch published videos, we record anonymous playback events (views, completions) to help creators understand reach. We do not sell personal data.

terms.s1Body: By using Streamora you agree to these terms. The platform is operated by the organization that hosts it. Access is by invitation only.
terms.s2Body: You retain ownership of videos you upload. By submitting content you grant the platform a license to host, transcode, display, and distribute it as part of the service.
terms.s3Body: All content is subject to review before publication. The platform may reject, remove, or take down content that violates policy or applicable law.
terms.s4Body: Do not upload unlawful, infringing, or harmful material. Do not attempt to bypass security, quotas, or moderation workflows.
terms.s5Body: The platform is provided as-is. To the extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the service.

privacy.s1Body: Streamora is a video publishing platform for invited stakeholders. This policy describes how we handle information when you use the service.
privacy.s2Body: We collect account information from Clerk (email, name), videos and metadata you upload, and anonymous playback analytics on published content.
privacy.s3Body: Data is used to operate the platform, moderate content, provide analytics to creators, and improve reliability. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.s4Body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your account data by contacting the platform operator. Published content may remain subject to editorial retention policies.
